The ALD growth rates for La 2O3 and Al 2O3 ﬁlms were 0.024 nm/ cycle and 0.18 nm/ cycle, respectively. The number of ALD cycles was determined accordingly to obtain the desired composition of La xAlyOz ﬁlms. For the growth of La 2.4AlO3.3 ﬁlm, four cycles of La 2O3 and one cycle of Al 2O3 were used.
